description: How good the logged predictions were, from the local ledger only (no Suunto call, writes nothing): overall, per kind and per `rule`: counts and, ONLY with 20+ scored in the group, hitRate, meanProbability, brier (lower is better), brierBaseRate (a brier below it means the probabilities carried information) and a calibration table. Below 20 scored the rates are null and verdict is 'insufficient': no claim is made. `basis` reports predictions scored from a confirmed draft_session_log apart. Also dueUnscored (call score_predictions) and recent.
name: get_prediction_stats
title: Get prediction statistics: hit rate, Brier score, calibration
